title: Automate onboarding for orion-alpha-13b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata and changelog
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Add automated onboarding for orion-alpha-13b v1.0: metadata files, performance profiles, and automatic changelog entry generation. Includes tests and docs. No breaking changes.
description: Context: Onboard orion-alpha-13b v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, calibrated performance profiles, and an automated changelog entry so release notes are generated consistently. Motivation: reduce manual onboarding steps, ensure perf profiles are validated and reproducible, and make changelogs auditable for downstream deploys. This PR adds: 1) models/orion-alpha-13b/metadata.yaml with schema-validated fields (architectures, tokenizer, default sampling config, licensing and dataset provenance), 2) perf/profiles/orion-alpha-13b-v1.0.json containing latency/throughput matrices across supported instance types and sequence lengths, 3) scripts/onboard_model.py to wire metadata -> registry and publish perf artifacts, 4) changelogs/auto/2024-11-22-orion-alpha-13b-v1.0.md generated by the automation pipeline, 5) unit/regression tests and a small integration test that exercises the onboard workflow, and 6) docs entry docs/models/orion-alpha.md describing model capabilities and recommended serving profiles. Checklist: [x] metadata schema validated against model-registry schema, [x] perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab outputs and sanity-checked, [x] changelog generation hooked into ci/model-registry.yaml pipeline, [x] unit tests added, [x] docs updated, [x] reviewers addressed. Migration notes: existing consumers that reference the registry by model name can continue to use "orion-alpha-13b:latest"; versioned perf profiles are available under perf/profiles and will be consumed by serving runtime selector. Follow-ups: add quantization recommendations to perf profiles (ENG-4988).
